title: Spiders (Horror)
description: This project adds spiders and a lot of more stuff
body:
**_GOTTEN AN UPDATE, A FILE HAS BEEN ADDED ON FILES THAT ADDS MORE MODS AND GUNS_****_~~
**_THERE IS A CURSEFORGE VERSION TOO CLICK _*[HERE](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/spiders-horror)

Prepare to face your deepest fears in this spine-chilling modpack that transforms your world into a living nightmare.

In Crawling Dread, the world has been overrun by mutated arthropods, grotesque spider queens, and venomous horrors that thrive in darkness. Every cave, forest, and abandoned ruin pulses with danger. The environment itself fights back with twisted biomes, web-choked dungeons, and infested strongholds where horror bosses await.

🌑 Features:
Terrifying Boss Encounters: Face off against giant spiders, venom lords, and other creeping nightmares with unique mechanics, phases, and jump-scares.

Immersive Sound Design: Experience every skitter, hiss, and scream with a custom ambient soundscape designed to keep you on edge.

Enhanced Arachnophobia Mode: For those who truly fear what crawls, activate extra creepy visuals, animations, and paranoia effects to test your limits.

Expanded Survival Mechanics: Food rot, sanity drains, and web entrapment push your survival instincts to the brink.

Cursed Gear & Spider Magic: Harness the power of your enemies with forbidden enchantments, venomous spells, and web-woven armor.

Multiplayer Compatible: Fight or flee with friends—or betray them when the web tightens.

🧠 Not Just Scary—It’s Strategic
You'll need more than bravery. You’ll need planning, resourcefulness, and perhaps even sacrifices to survive the infestation. Every sound could be the last thing you hear.

🕸️ For Players Who Dare...
If you’re looking for a relaxing adventure, turn back now.
If you’re ready to confront your fears, descend into madness, and become the hunter or the hunted, welcome to your worst nightmare.
